_about: PARKED DRAFT (docs/narrative/pending/). The ground each story opponent claims, for World's shifting-arena stage assignment (docs/narrative/opponent-grounds.md). Weights are 1 to 3 (proposed; World and Game Design tune). 'suits' and 'avoids' name biomes, place kinds and place states the ring passes through. A home is colour and set piece, never numbers. Options for Orb; written to survive any lore pick. Claude-written.
rules: A home is colour and set piece, never numbers.
The picker lists candidate rings first; each goes to the opponent whose claim scores highest; ties go to the rival.
Wear (damaged or fallen places from earlier in the run) is ground too.
No claim lists a school, hospital, place of worship or a polar outpost.

RIVAL.why: He drags it up the stair so everyone can see him win.
RIVAL.line: Up here, everyone can see you lose.

EMPRESS.why: She claims the open plain so there is nowhere to hide from her.
EMPRESS.line: Wide open ground, insect. Nowhere to hide!

CYBORG.why: The wreckage is already there, so it is free fuel.
CYBORG.line: Lots of wreckage out here. Free fuel!
CYBORG.legal: Hunger on wreckage only; nothing puts a living person on his menu.

PROTAGONIST.why: He drags it to the water so nobody's roof breaks.
PROTAGONIST.line: Keep it over the water. Nobody's roof breaks!

fallbacks.any_boss: the stage with the most standing cities, whole size, no claim line

fallbacks.rival_steps_in: the ground of the boss who escaped
fallbacks.tie: the rival wins; the other waits for a later stage
fallbacks.no_ring_fits: best-scoring candidate; the picture carries the fantasy
